svg.title: Aftergraph actor — idle
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor is available and not actively processing work.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — thinking
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor is processing context or reasoning.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — planning
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor is structuring an intended course of action.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — executing
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor is taking an authorized action.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — inspecting
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor is examining an artifact, system, or evidence.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — waiting
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor is paused on an external dependency, event, or timer.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — blocked
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor cannot continue until a blocker is resolved.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — approval-required
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Continuation requires an explicit human authority decision.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — verifying
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor is checking claims or outcomes against evidence or policy; this state is not itself a verification verdict.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — completed
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor execution completed; this state does not imply independent verification or acceptance.

svg.title: Aftergraph actor — failed
svg.desc: Standalone runtime-state composition derived from canonical anatomy. Actor execution failed to complete the required operation; this is not an independent verification verdict.

svg.title: Aftergraph Entity — avatar
svg.desc: Compact avatar derived from the same halo, head, face, and shading anatomy as the full entity character.
